mechanism_narrative: EGFR (RTK) and IL6ST/gp130 (cytokine receptor, no intrinsic kinase) are co-expressed in aged skeletal muscle fibroblasts and MuSC. Under forced proximity via flexible_GS8 (~40 A), EGFR's kinase transphosphorylates IL6ST's intracellular tyrosines, creating novel docking sites for GRB2-SHC-SOS (RAS-MAPK), PIK3R1 (PI3K-AKT), and STAT3/STAT1/STAT5. PLCgamma is sterically excluded by the EGFR-IL6ST co-cluster geometry, analogous to H2F. The biased output combines EGFR-driven MAPK/PI3K with IL6ST-driven STAT3 signaling, shifting muscle cells toward a young transcriptional program (up: structural/contractile genes; down: aged IEGs and inflammatory markers).
